title: Adjunction on homology respects cocycle section classes
statement: Let g:X→Y be a flat scheme morphism [def-weil-flat-morphism], K a nonnegative complex of O_Y-modules, L a nonnegative complex of O_X-modules, and q:K→g_*L. Let c:g^*K→L be its adjoint under the tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For every open V⊆Y and p∈ℕ, the class map sectionHomologyClass K V p followed by sections of the adjoint of Hᵖ(c)∘(Hᵖ(g^*K)≅g^*Hᵖ(K))⁻¹ equals Hᵖ(pushforwardComplexSections g q V) followed by sectionHomologyClass L (g⁻¹V) p. The section maps and class maps are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-section-complex], and exactness supplies the homology comparison [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective]. No resolution, augmentation, or higher-direct-image comparison is assumed.

proof.text: The complex adjunction gives q = unit_K followed by g_*c degreewise. On a section cocycle s over V its image is c(1 tensor eta(s)). The explicit unit formula identifies the adjoint map on Hᵖ(K).

Exactness of flat tensor pullback identifies the class of the pulled-back cocycle with pullback of its class, by the kernel/cokernel homology comparison. Naturality of exact sheafification and its unit identifies the resulting maps with the canonical section class maps. Equality on cocycles descends to homology; boundaries map to boundaries. This applies also at p=0 and on the empty open.

theorem flatPullbackHomologyAdjoint_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [Flat g]
    (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℕ) (L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
    (q : K ⟶ ((pushforward g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L)
    (V : Y.Opens) (p : ℕ) :
    sectionHomologyClass K V p ≫
      Hom.app ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv _ _
        (((K.sc p).mapHomologyIso (tensorPullback g)).inv ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homEquiv _ _ |>.symm q))) V =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
        (pushforwardComplexSections g q V) ≫ sectionHomologyClass L (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) p
